title: The Death of Alexander
objective: After this level you can explain what happened when Alexander died.
summary: Alexander died in Babylon in 323 BCE, aged 32, with no adult heir; his family was killed off and his generals fought over the empire until 281 BCE.

cards.headline: Alexander conquered an empire. He never said who should get it.
cards.body: Asked on his deathbed, he may have given the most dangerous answer possible.

cards.headline: Babylon, 323 BCE
cards.body: In Babylon, Alexander fell ill after a long banquet and drinking bout. Ten days later, on June 13, 323 BCE, he died, aged 32. What killed him is still debated: malaria, typhoid fever and poison are the favorite theories. Plutarch thought the poison story a fabrication.

cards.headline: ’To the strongest’
cards.body: The historian Diodorus says the dying Alexander handed his ring to his general Perdiccas. Asked who should have his kingdom, he answered: ’to the strongest.’ Whether or not he said it, that’s exactly what happened. It’s like leaving your house to ’whoever grabs the keys first’.

mascot.line: Three little words, and a very long fight over what they meant.

cards.headline: Two kings, no king
cards.body: Alexander had named no heir, so his generals made two kings: his half-brother Philip Arrhidaeus and his son by Roxana, Alexander IV, born after his death. Neither truly ruled. In 310 BCE the general Cassander had the boy and his mother Roxana killed. Alexander’s family was gone; his generals, the Successors, fought on until 281 BCE.

cards.fact: Alexander’s death in 323 BCE ends the Classical age.
cards.context: Remember Level 1’s timeline? The Classical age runs to his death, and the Hellenistic age begins, lasting until Rome takes Egypt in 30 BCE. One man’s death marks the border between two eras.

cards.headline: The death of Alexander
learned: Died in Babylon in 323 BCE, aged 32
His son was killed in 310 BCE

questions.prompt: According to Diodorus, whom did the dying Alexander name to inherit his kingdom?

options.label: His general Ptolemy
options.rationale: Diodorus says he handed his ring to Perdiccas.

questions.explanation: Diodorus says Alexander answered “to the strongest” and gave his ring to Perdiccas.

questions.prompt: Why did Alexander’s empire end up with his generals instead of his family?

options.label: He left no adult heir, and his young son was killed
His family refused the throne
options.rationale: They were made kings, then killed.

options.label: Macedonian law barred sons from ruling
Rome gave the empire to the generals

questions.explanation: With no adult heir, the generals set up two figurehead kings; Cassander had the boy Alexander IV killed in 310 BCE.

questions.prompt: On Level 1’s timeline of Greek eras, what does Alexander’s death mark?

options.label: The start of the Dark Age
The start of the Archaic age
The start of the Hellenistic age

questions.explanation: His death in 323 BCE ends the Classical age and begins the Hellenistic age.
